description.narrative:
The KCS Gateway (Knowledge – Connection – Sustainability Gateway) initiative aims to develop a digital knowledge ecosystem integrated with an e-commerce platform to promote sustainable development and the consumption of OCOP products. The initiative seeks to strengthen digital competencies, green entrepreneurship, and market access for ethnic minority women in Lao Cai Province. The project will be implemented from November 2025 to October 2026 across three target communes: Sín Chéng, Mường Hum, and Hạnh Phúc in Lao Cai.
The primary objectives of the initiative include: (1) developing the KCS digital ecosystem that integrates an online learning platform with an e-commerce system; (2) delivering both basic and advanced digital skills training for ethnicminority women, enabling themto participate effectively in e-commerce; and (3) facilitating market linkages, digital marketing, and the promotion of “green” OCOP products to enhance sustainable livelihoods for women and local communities. Specific targets include reaching at least 300 individuals, providing direct training to at least 120 women, and establishing a platform operation team comprising at least 45 members.
Key activities of the project include: (i) conducting a baseline assessment and digital readiness survey, followed by dissemination through an inception workshop; (ii) developing the core KCS software system, integrating an e-learning module and connecting it to the e-commerce gateway; (iii) delivering in-person training courses (basicand advanced) and offering online classes on digital literacy, digital marketing, livestreaming, video production, and product description; (iv) selecting, training, and supporting the platform operation team; (v) identifying, digitizing, and onboarding atleast 20 green OCOP products; and (vi) implementing communication activities, monitoring and evaluation, and the final handover of the system to local partners.
Direct target groups include women—particularly ethnic minority women (approximately 300beneficiaries), OCOP producer groups and cooperatives (at least 15 units), students and support staff involved in platform operations (at least 45 individuals), as well as local organizations engaged in technical collaboration and sustainability efforts.TheKCS Gateway is designed as an open and scalable system and will be transferred to the Lao Cai Provincial Women’s Union and Thai Nguyen University (Lao Cai Branch) for continued operation after project completion.

participating-org.narrative: Thai Nguyen University was established under Government Decree No. 31/CP dated April 4, 1994, based on the reorganization and consolidation of universities in Thai Nguyen City. Thai Nguyen University is a regional, multidisciplinary center for education, scientific research, and technology transfer. It is 1 of 5 universities in Vietnam operating under the two-tier university model and is entrusted with the role of serving as a human resource training hub for provinces, universities, colleges, vocationalhigh schools, and vocational training institutions within the region. In addition, the University carries out scientific research and technology transfer missions, making significant contributions to the economic, political, cultural, and social development of the Northern midland and mountainous areas. Thai Nguyen University has legal status, its own seal, and its own bank account.
